anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning as intended.
Trading system shows zero active trades and zero profit/loss, which is unusual for a trading platform and may indicate a malfunction or misconfiguration.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load, potentially by redistributing workloads or upgrading hardware.
Review AI system configuration and logs to ensure it is correctly set up to generate learning cycles and opportunities.
Evaluate trading strategies and system configuration to ensure trades are being executed as expected.

recommendations.action: Investigate and address the high CPU load immediately to prevent potential system failures or degraded performance.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability, affecting trading operations and user experience.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough review of the AI system to identify and resolve issues preventing it from generating learning cycles and opportunities.
